name: St. John's wort
metabolism: This material contains multiple constituents and has no single ingredient-level metabolic pathway. Composition and constituent-specific metabolism must be distinguished; this entry does not yet provide a verified constituent-by-constituent account.
summary: Hypericum perforatum, commonly known as St. John's wort, is a flowering plant with a long history of use in traditional medicine, including for wounds and depression. It can interact with medicines by accelerating their metabolism.
